technology_analysis.description: A modular monolith news aggregation and economic data monitoring platform with multi-tenant architecture. Features web crawling pipeline (Crawl4AI), news processing with LLM analysis, economic data tracking via AKShare, real-time dashboards with customizable widgets, and multi-channel alerting system. Built as a monorepo using Turborepo with NestJS backend API and Next.js frontend.
